clues.text: Abram came to the Oak of Moreh at this place, and the LORD promised the land to his offspring.
Jacob bought the plot of ground where he camped here from the sons of Hamor for a hundred pieces of silver.
To avenge their sister Dinah, Simeon and Levi slaughtered every male of this city while the men were still in pain.
The bones of Joseph, brought up from Egypt, were buried at this place on land Jacob had purchased.
Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel here, made a covenant, and set a large stone under an oak.
Abimelech captured this city, killed its people, demolished it, and sowed it with salt.
After Solomon died, Rehoboam went to this place because all Israel had gathered there to make him king.
